newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on rising arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on rising arrivals.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Friday lost earlier gains, falling to 1,141/1,142 rupees per quintal from 1,149/1,150 rupees, dealers said.
Absence of fresh overseas buying and sustained pressure on arrivals at producing centres prompted fresh bull liquidation.

"Foreign buyers particularly from Europe are seeking Indian castoroil at 675 dollars per tonne for the long delivery but demand for near delivery is virtually absent," said Dilip Thakkar, a leading operator.
Groundnut oil was steady at 356/357 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes while physical buying was at a low ebb.

In Rajkot spot groundnut oil moved down by five rupees at 550/555 rupees per 15 kg. In Bombay imported palm oil rose by 2/3 rupees at 268/269 rupees per 10 kg amid limited offerings by local importers following reports of a rally in the world market.
